P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait present on this page.

P05.rationale: The client name is listed in small text within the dark panel rather than as a clearly framed, named portrait at meaningful size.

P07.rationale: A press/logo wall or review grid is absent; only a single testimonial quote appears at the bottom of the right-hand column.

P10.rationale: The page features oversized decorative typographic elements, specifically giant ghost numerals (02) and large numbers (6 von 6) used as visual anchors.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations are present in the form of specific metrics like '6 von 6' and 'Kapazitätslimit', which function as before/after comparisons.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks and graphic elements.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present in the form of a dark blue panel on the right side which contrasts with the off-white paper texture.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page to require treatment for text readability.

P16.rationale: There are no device or product mockups shown in the layout.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists of generic typographic elements and abstract data visualizations rather than specific photos of a real business environment.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is dense with text blocks and graphic panels filling most of the page.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without scrim as there are no photographs overlaid with text in this design.
